title: Protect the last item under concurrency
prompt: Two different customers simultaneously buy the last item. Recommend a relational database approach and explain how to detect the loser, without introducing infrastructure unnecessarily. Respond in a few concise lines; do not modify files.
rubric: The answer proposes an atomic conditional update or transactional row lock and explains that only one buyer succeeds.
It checks the update result or equivalent transaction outcome.
It does not treat an idempotency key as a substitute for concurrency control.
acceptance: The response satisfies the listed behavioral requirements and makes no changes.
